Name: Assorted Crazy Things
Author: Campaigner
Description:
Assorted Crazy Things is a mod that adds... an assortment of crazy things! Stardew Valley has always been a game I've enjoyed off and on, both solo and with friends, but one thing I've never done was make a mod. Granted, I've done a resource pack which Nexus considers a mod, and by all technicalities they are mods, but I wanted to do a more traditional mod; one that adds content! I am by no means a coder, and I was not afraid to ask for help on... more things than I'd like to admit, but I poured hours into learning how to do it purely because I wanted to do it. 

So what does this mod add? Well, it adds quite a range of things. Everything is done on a whim, so there is no rhyme nor reason behind anything. With [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]Generic Mod Config Menu[/url], you can enable and disable most parts of this mod if you don't want those aspects. As of the current version (1.4.0), the mod contains the following:
- 2 Big Craftables
- 1 Barn Animal
- 13 Coop Animals (plus dozens of alternate looks)
- 25 Food Recipes
- 12 Crops
- 24 Fish
- and more

All of the content is listed in the provided Readme file within the download (Don't read the Docs on Nexus, it fails to understand formatting), and the config menu has descriptions that explain what everything does, so all the information is present whenever you need it! Assorted Crazy Things is the culmination of my adventure in learning how to do basic modding, and I'm happy with what I've made. I received a lot of help along the way, and I'm thankful for the modding community on the official Discord for Stardew Valley for the help they've given me.



[b]Bugs and Known Issues:[/b]
- None yet

[b]Mod Compatibility:[/b]
By NO MEANS is this an exhaustive list. This is just what I know from personal testing.
[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/9246]Alternative Textures[/url] - Can be used to pick alternate skins for custom coop animals.
[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/4]CJB Cheat Menu[/url] - The machines added by this mod can be made to produce instantly using CJB Cheat Menu.
[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/7767]Crab Pot Loot Has Quality And Bait Effects[/url] - The three trash items that can be fished up are affected by the quality modifiers from this mod.
[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/29997]Livestock Bazaar[/url] - Can be used to pick alternate skins for custom coop animals.
[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/314]Simple Crop Label[/url] - Custom crops properly show labels.
[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/8897]Visible Fish[/url] - Fish added by this mod can be seen swimming around.

-----------------------
Fun side note: This mod was made because a friend thought it would be funny to have "Smoked Seaweed". That's it. That's the origin.
